currentRoundInspection.method: Two aerial photographs inspected in browser and compared with standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. No bespoke survey research or redistributed photograph.

pictures.observations: North garden facade: long pale/rose palace, three rows of framed windows, projecting central bay, two taller pavilions with differently colored tiered roofs/finials, broad steep main roof, paired stone belvederes and front garden retaining edge. Lower courtyard and south gate behind.

South courtyard: central bay with faceted cap, broad dark roof/dormers/chimneys, west green/east gray pavilion roofs, opposing curved stair arms, arcade bays at terrace ends, U-shaped flat lower wings, angular south bastions, decorated gate and straight bridge-like approach across the dry moat.
